verdict.rationale: Appwrite's auth docs explicitly claim presence: tracking which signed-in users are active and broadcasting online, typing, and viewing status in realtime. This is backed by general realtime event support. It is a single first-party line, though, with no detail on the API or limits, no confirmation that arbitrary ephemeral state can be broadcast beyond the named statuses, and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed presence API documentation, explicit arbitrary ephemeral broadcast between clients, independent or hands-on verification.
